issues.title: Data Privacy & GDPR Compliance
issues.hover_description: ESRS S2: GDPR Art. 83 - fines up to EUR20M or 4% global turnover. 2023 EU fines: EUR1.4B total. Consumer trust: NPS drops 18pts after breach.

issues.title: Cybersecurity & Ransomware Risk
issues.hover_description: ESRS G1: Average ransomware payment $1.5M (2023). NIS2 Directive mandates 24h incident reporting. Critical infrastructure exposure.

issues.title: AI Fairness & Algorithmic Bias
issues.hover_description: ESRS S2: EU AI Act High-Risk classification (hiring, credit, healthcare AI). Algorithmic bias litigation risk. Model cards and impact assessments mandatory.

issues.title: Digital Divide & Access Inequity
issues.hover_description: ESRS S3: 2.7B people lack internet access. SaaS pricing and accessibility barriers. EU Web Accessibility Directive. UN SDG 10 - reduce inequality.

issues.title: Data Centre Energy & Carbon Footprint
issues.hover_description: Data centres consume 2% of global electricity. ESRS E1: Scope 2 + Scope 3 Cat 11 (use of sold products). Hyperscaler PPA commitments under pressure.

issues.title: Remote Worker Surveillance & Autonomy
issues.hover_description: ESRS S1: 78% of companies use employee monitoring software (ExpressVPN 2023). Erosion of trust and autonomy. EU AI Act workplace monitoring provisions.

issues.title: Platform Monopoly & Market Concentration
issues.hover_description: ESRS G1: EU Digital Markets Act designates GAFA as gatekeepers. Antitrust fines: EUR4.3B (Google, 2022). Market foreclosure harms SME competitors.

issues.title: Open Source Dependency Risk
issues.hover_description: 96% of codebases contain open source (Synopsys 2023). Log4Shell-style vulnerabilities propagate instantly. EU Cyber Resilience Act OSS provisions.

issues.title: Digital Addiction & Mental Health Impact
issues.hover_description: ESRS S3: social media linked to depression in adolescents. UK Online Safety Act. Platform design features (dark patterns, infinite scroll) as intentional harm.

issues.title: AI Hallucinations & Misinformation Risk
issues.hover_description: ESRS G1/S3: LLM hallucination in healthcare/legal contexts creates liability. EU AI Act transparency requirements. Trust erosion if not addressed.
